summary: Backend-only validation of the Repair Delivery payment gate (prep + deliver + legend injection). 10/11 pytest cases pass; the single failure is a test-ordering artifact (quo_test_rep_a is already Entregada after the WARNING flow runs, so the subsequent prep assertion for quote_status='Reparada' no longer applies). All functional acceptance criteria are proven: PREP returns delivery_mode 'warning'/'normal'/'blocked' + payment_validated + block_message as specified; deliver on blocked quote without exception header returns 400 with the exact block message; warning flow returns 428 UNPAID_CONFIRM: ... then 200 with the literal legend injected into Nota de Entrega PDF; normal flow returns 200 directly WITHOUT legend; irregular exception valve (x-exception-reason) on blocked quote returns 200 WITH legend; non-repair quote (fast_track quo_b8b81ce5405c) is rejected with 400 'Esta acción solo aplica a cotizaciones de reparación'. Legend presence/absence was verified by extracting text from the generated PDF via pdfplumber at /app/backend/uploads/NotaEntrega_Reparacion_NE-YYYY-NNNN.pdf.

minor.issue: Returns 500 (ResponseValidationError) because repair fixtures quo_test_rep_a/b/c lack subtotal_usd/total_usd/exchange_rate/total_bs. Does not affect targeted repair endpoints but breaks the general list for admin until fixtures are completed or the Quote response_model is relaxed.

action_items: Decide whether to backfill subtotal_usd/total_usd/exchange_rate/total_bs on the three repair test fixtures (or make those fields optional in the Quote list response_model) so GET /api/quotes stops 500ing in environments that have these fixtures.
critical_code_review_comments: quote_actions.py:2862 — _repair_delivery_mode() considers warning if quote_status in ('Reparada','Pagada') OR repaired_at/paid_at set. This is correct and matches the spec, but note the OR with timestamps means a mis-set repaired_at (without the status change) would still unlock warning mode; consider a tighter check if that risk is real.

quote_actions.py:2846 — REPAIR_DELIVER_BLOCK_MSG uses U+2019 curly quotes around 'Reparado' and 'Pagado' while the spec text uses straight quotes. Visible in the 400 response and block_message; may break any string-equality consumers.

quote_actions.py:2998 — When delivery_mode != 'normal' (both warning and blocked-with-exception) the legend is appended. This covers the irregular-valve case correctly. The join uses ' | '; consider using a newline so the legend sits on its own line in Observaciones for readability.
quote_actions.py:2985 — 428 detail is a single string 'UNPAID_CONFIRM:...'; frontend relies on prefix check. Consider returning a structured JSON (code + message) for forward-compat.
Fixture gap: /api/quotes general list currently 500s on these fixtures (missing financial fields).

success_rate.backend: 100% functional (6/6 scenarios proven); 10/11 pytest cases pass — 1 fails only due to post-delivery state of a consumed fixture

seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded fixtures cli_test_repair, quo_test_rep_a/b/c and te_test_rep_a1/b1/c1 (left in whatever state the suite leaves them: a and c now Entregada, b Entregada; main agent cleans up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The three repair fixtures are now consumed (equipos entregados). If re-running the suite, re-seed quo_test_rep_a/b/c and their taller_equipos to the original states ('Reparada'+warning, 'Pagada'+normal, 'Aprobada'+blocked) or recreate fresh ones. PDFs are persisted under /app/backend/uploads/NotaEntrega_Reparacion_NE-*.pdf; the test extracts text via pdfplumber. Non-repair guard uses quo_b8b81ce5405c (fast_track) — any non-repair quote works.
rca of the issue: N/A — all documented behaviours implemented correctly. Only the ordering of the prep_warning assertion inside the same run matters; curl captured BEFORE delivery confirmed quote_status='Reparada' + delivery_mode='warning' for quo_test_rep_a.
